name: 5-HTP
summary: The precursor to serotonin. In some countries it is sold OTC as a supplement for mood stabilisation and insomnia. It is frequently used as a recovery supplement following the use of MDMA/any other drug that depletes serotonin. It is not recommended to mix this drug with other serotonin releasers.
advisory: Avoid: Anything which releases serotonin, such as MDMA and DXM.
doseBasis: NOTE: Do not take this while on a serotonergic drug. It is recommended to wait at least 24 hours after taking MDMA (/similar) due to the concern of serotonin syndrome.

pharmacology.text: 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP), used medically as oxitriptan, is a naturally occurring amino acid and chemical precursor as well as a metabolic intermediate in the biosynthesis of the neurotransmitter serotonin.

uses.text: As a drug, it is used in the treatment of depression and for certain other indications.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, drowsiness and headache. Because it raises serotonin levels, taking it alongside drugs that also raise serotonin can cause serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 常見反應包括噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、嗜睡與頭痛。由於它會提高血清素濃度，若與其他也會提高血清素的藥物一起使用，可能引起血清素症候群，這種狀況可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见反应包括恶心、呕吐、腹泻、嗜睡与头痛。由于它会提高血清素浓度，若与其他也会提高血清素的药物一起使用，可能引起血清素症候群，这种状况可能危及生命。

fact.en: Commercial 5-HTP is extracted from the seeds of Griffonia simplicifolia, a West African climbing shrub whose seeds are unusually rich in it. In the body, the enzyme that makes 5-HTP from tryptophan is the slow step in building serotonin.
fact.zh: 市售的5-HTP是從西非藤狀灌木Griffonia simplicifolia的種子中萃取的，這種種子含有特別豐富的5-HTP。在體內，由色胺酸製造5-HTP的酵素是合成血清素過程中的限速步驟。
fact.zhHans: 市售的5-HTP是从西非藤状灌木Griffonia simplicifolia的种子中萃取的，这种种子含有特别丰富的5-HTP。在体内，由色胺酸制造5-HTP的酵素是合成血清素过程中的限速步骤。
